result.title: ActWorld-JEPA: Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models Meet Latent Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
result.summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable future prediction in latent space without pixel reconstruction. However, latent predictive consistency alone does not establish the relative driving quality of candidate plans. We present ActWorld-JEPA, a joint-embedding formulation for candidate-based driving. Where Plan-Conditioned JEPA (PC-JEPA) uses global and step-wise trajectory intentions to guide recurrent latent prediction, then combines the predicted future with the current scene through gated cross-attention; Relational Residual Reranking ($R^3$) models agreement and discrepancy between plan and future representations under planning supervision, yielding bounded, gated residual corrections to the base planning scores. This formulation connects latent prediction to candidate selection using only observed context and proposed trajectories at inference. Benchmark-specific implementations report 94.1 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, with the final selector calibrated using aggregate NAVTEST feedback, and 91.6 and 42.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and navhard, respectively. The nuScenes evaluation reports a mean $L_2$ error of 1.20 m and a predicted collision rate of 0.76% over 1--6 s. This work provides an effective path from JEPA's predictive representations to driving decisions informed by anticipated consequences.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ActWorld-JEPA，一种用于端到端自动驾驶的联合嵌入预测世界模型：用轨迹意图引导循环 latent 预测，并通过关系残差重排序（R³）把计划与未来表征的一致/差异转化为对候选规划分数的有界门控修正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以 latent 预测结果对候选做门控残差重排序」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中基于 latent 状态的推理轨迹验证与候选选择机制；但研究对象是自动驾驶世界模型，与 VLM 推理仅有概念层面的间接联系。
